required_exact_reproduction: N=1 public candidate multiset globally and on every track
N=16 public candidate multiset globally and on every track
N=1 and N=16 official TP/FP/FN globally and on every track
N=16 candidates remain a multiset subset of N=1

relation_definitions.official_matching: deterministic maximum-cardinality one-to-one matching identical to Exp07
relation_definitions.candidate_neighborhood: all reference boundary instances of the same type within the official tolerance; timestamp multiplicity is preserved

false_positive_partition.isolated: unmatched candidate with zero eligible references
false_positive_partition.single_reference_excess: unmatched candidate with exactly one eligible reference; conservative duplicate-like lower bound
false_positive_partition.ambiguous_near: unmatched candidate with two or more eligible references

same_channel_successor_relation.same_unique_reference: two successive N=16 candidates of the same type and private channel each have the same sole eligible reference
same_channel_successor_relation.distinct_unique_references: they have different sole eligible references
same_channel_successor_relation.one_or_both_isolated: at least one has no eligible reference
same_channel_successor_relation.ambiguous: at least one has multiple eligible references

relation_definitions.same_note_boundary_relation: for each annotated note identity, report whether N=16 supplies onset candidates, offset candidates, both, or neither within tolerance on the supervised private channel

required_metrics: isolated versus single-reference-excess versus ambiguous-near false positives
candidate proximity to any reference and to a same-channel reference at preregistered tolerances
successive same-type same-channel relation counts and gap distributions
N=1 fronts per N=16 causal episode
per-note onset-only, offset-only, both and neither support
interpretation_guards: proximity is evidence of relation, not proof of common acoustic cause
a private model channel is diagnostic state and is not a public string prediction
multiple eligible references are reported as ambiguous and are not forced to one identity
same-position candidate and reference multiplicity must never be deduplicated
the official 50 ms tolerance can inflate apparent relations in dense passages; narrower preregistered tolerances must also be reported
the offline ground-truth relation audit is not a live association algorithm
no filtering duration or future decoder change is selected in this audit

decision_rule.claim_temporal_duplicates_dominate_only_: single-reference-excess is more than 50 percent of official false positives and the direction is consistent in all 12 family-arrangement groups
decision_rule.claim_isolated_false_positives_dominate_: isolated candidates are more than 50 percent of official false positives and the direction is consistent in all 12 family-arrangement groups
decision_rule.otherwise: report a mixed or unresolved mechanism
